title: Care Package
description: Play an Intcode-powered breakout game: count blocks, then beat the game by tracking the ball.
writeup:
## Approach

The Intcode program drives an arcade cabinet that outputs screen updates as `(x, y, tile_id)` triplets. The special coordinate `(-1, 0)` updates the score display.

## Part 1

Run the program to completion and parse all output triplets into a screen dictionary. Count tiles with id 2 (blocks).

## Part 2

Set `memory[0] = 2` to insert quarters. The game now expects joystick input: -1 (left), 0 (neutral), or +1 (right). The winning strategy is trivially simple: always move the paddle toward the ball's x-position. Since the paddle moves one step per frame and the ball also moves one step per frame, this perfect tracking never misses. Use `run_until_block()` to process each game frame, read the ball and paddle positions from outputs, and provide the joystick direction as input.
